sloka: सौम्य शीघ्रमितो गत्वा शैलमोषधिपर्वतम् ।पूर्वं ते कथितो यो ऽसौ वीर जाम्बवता शुभः ।। ६.१०२.२१ ।।
transliteration: saumya śīghramito gatvā śailamoṣadhiparvatam ।pūrvaṁ te kathito yo 'sau vīra jāmbavatā śubhaḥ ।। 6.102.21 ।।

translations.english: 'His face is radiant and pleasing to see. His palms are like red lotuses and his eyes are so pleasant'.
